name: shared_frame
description: The `account` partial trap by construction: two bugs in two different modules whose failing tests all raise InvalidValue at the same line of the shared helper checks.ensure_at_least, so frame clustering merges them into one goal. booking.reserve demands at least 1 remaining seat instead of 0 (constant; two tests), and pricing.total swaps the arguments of ensure_at_least(seats, 1, ...) so any order of two or more seats is rejected (argument swap; four tests). Each correct fix alone makes only its own tests pass and is therefore a partial of the merged goal; the two partials have disjoint newly-passing sets and must be paired or committed as partials. checks.py's own tests pin `<` in the helper, so mutating the shared line regresses them. Six tests fail, nineteen pass.
